units.name: model
units.about: Schema-blind value primitives that both sides need: hex text and the canonical byte writer for digests. No clock, no ids, no record vocabulary.

units.name: store
units.about: Keys and bytes only: KV traits and errors, the laststore native run homes, batch transaction and publication, write queue, read context and budgets, rows, encryption at rest, byte backup, restore of files, the mutation log of commit bytes, cleanup, CAS delete, space, disk read receipts, and the process clock.

units.name: database
units.about: Everything that gives bytes meaning: schemas, fields, molecules, atoms, tips, counters, mutations, queries, the warm set, purge, retention, conflicts, aggregates, alternate keys, proteins, key families and key validation, logical capture (cloud frontier), file-blob reachability, sharing, access, signing keys, process memory budget.

units.name: transport
units.about: The reqwest backup HTTP client: account credentials, the byte backup client, upload, download, feed, URLs.

mixed_files.storage/disk_pack/view.rs: store; install_committed swaps the disk root and publishes warm-set invalidation, schema keys, path protection under one lock
mixed_files.storage/disk_pack/transaction.rs: store; PendingBatch carries Sources, LogicalPathRecord, PreparedCoreMemory, DeferReservation
mixed_files.storage/disk_pack/transaction/request.rs: store; reserves PathProtection, enforces logical capture, derives source keys
mixed_files.storage/disk_pack/read.rs: store; ReadContext holds warm-set paths and key reservations
mixed_files.storage/disk_pack/read/probes.rs: store; counter/body pair probes validate LastDB key families
mixed_files.storage/disk_pack/native_routing.rs: store; routes keys to atoms/tips/proteins/indexes collections by LastDB family
mixed_files.storage/disk_pack/run_admission.rs: store; open checks the logical key format and replay floor through AtomStore
mixed_files.storage/disk_pack/run_node/creation.rs: store; creation writes the logical key format marker
mixed_files.storage/disk_pack/run_restore/proof.rs: store; reader forks and budgets, dispatches the semantic schema/atom/tip proofs
mixed_files.storage/disk_pack/run_restore/snapshot_i: store; file locks plus logical capture identity rebase
mixed_files.storage/disk_pack/byte_backup/run_source: store; byte capture verifies the logical inclusion map
mixed_files.storage/disk_pack/file_dependencies/nati: store; CAS byte proof takes the atom-level FileDependency
mixed_files.db_operations/atom_store/bounded_range.r: database; generic bounded range walk over key space, a store contract item
mixed_files.sharing/blob_cas/dedup.rs: database; writes file blob bytes and the blob counter in one request
mixed_files.memory_budget/process_budget.rs: database; one process budget for the warm set and the store's pending bytes
